basic.title: Senior Software Engineer
basic.location: West Islip, NY | Remote or Hybrid
basic.summary: Senior Cloud Security & Platform Architect designing, securing, and operating production-grade infrastructure across Azure, AWS, GCP, and DigitalOcean. Builds multi-region Kubernetes platforms, secure-by-default golden paths, DevSecOps controls (SAST, DAST, secrets scanning, SBOM, policy-as-code, and supply-chain security), cloud-native observability, and SLO frameworks. Proven impact includes MTTR reduction, 40%+ lower security and audit effort, 25-30% cloud spend reduction, and 99.9% uptime across mission-critical workloads. Microsoft, AWS, and Google certified; experienced leading platform and security initiatives across 20+ engineers and translating SOC 2, ISO 27001, CIS, NIST, and OWASP into engineering practice.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Architected an Internal Developer Platform using Python, Kubernetes, Terraform, and cloud-native services to standardize infrastructure provisioning, application deployment, and operational workflows across engineering teams.
Built reusable Python platform services and automation frameworks that simplified infrastructure operations, accelerated developer onboarding, and reduced manual engineering effort.

Designed self-service infrastructure capabilities using Infrastructure as Code, enabling application teams to provision secure and consistent cloud resources across development, staging, and production environments.

Modernized Kubernetes platform architecture through reusable Helm deployments, standardized release patterns, automated health validation, and progressive deployment strategies to improve production reliability.
Developed cloud-native platform services and automation integrations connecting Azure, AWS, and internal engineering systems to improve scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency.
Established platform reliability practices through centralized monitoring, distributed tracing, automated alerting, and production health visibility across cloud-native workloads.

Collaborated with security, infrastructure, and application engineering teams to implement secure-by-default platform capabilities, improving governance, deployment consistency, and developer experience.
Optimized cloud infrastructure utilization through workload analysis, resource lifecycle automation, and capacity planning while maintaining highly available production services.
Led technical design discussions, code reviews, and engineering standards around Kubernetes, cloud architecture, Python development, and Infrastructure as Code practices.
Created platform documentation, architectural guidelines, and operational runbooks that improved onboarding, incident response, and long-term system maintainability.
